reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message to say I'd noted the date: Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is 25 November.

I couldn't check that date against anything. The shared drive shows no Brackenwater account files. I also don't keep notes of my own between conversations, so her message and my reply in that thread are now the only written record. I told her that if the date needs to go in the account profile, someone with access to it will have to add it.

Nothing else is needed. A renewal date isn't a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the North team.
